module: Complete and defend the release record

lesson.title: Case: decide whether the release dossier is complete
lesson.summary: Make a bounded release decision and record its evidence and unresolved conditions.

prerequisites.reason: The final release decision needs a supported assessment-route conclusion.
The final dossier needs the required declaration content and supporting evidence.
The final release needs a valid marking and access decision.
The final release needs the applicable registration destination and recorded gaps.

blocks: The **market-release case** joins the decisions without claiming an all-law legal clearance. In a dated decision record identify provider/deployer roles, intended purpose, system/version, territory and release action. Complete the Article 5 precheck and Article 6 classification, including any other applicable law. Record which provisions apply at that date; these exercises stipulate a supported temporal interpretation of their chosen procedures.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 5–6, 17, 40–49, 111 and 113; Annexes IV–VIII

blocks: Northbridge v1 is stipulated to materially rank recruitment candidates for an ordinary private employer. Its case dossier contains a supported non-prohibited-use analysis, Annex III classification, Section 2 evidence, Article 17 processes, Annex IV technical documentation, recorded Annex VI checks, a complete signed declaration, accessible digital CE marking and the appropriate provider registration. Within these stated checks, a supported readiness conclusion can be recorded, with ongoing obligations and named owners.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 5–6, 17, 40–49, 111 and 113; Annexes IV–VIII

blocks: Harbour v1 is stipulated to require sector third-party assessment. Its certificate refers to v0 and the assessor's relevant scope has not been verified. Mark the release **not ready on the stated evidence**: resolve competence/scope and version coverage, and obtain the applicable assessment evidence. A launch promise is not an Article 46 sector derogation. A separate sector-law review remains necessary.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 5–6, 17, 40–49, 111 and 113; Annexes IV–VIII

blocks: If Northbridge later changes its intended purpose or makes an unplanned compliance-affecting modification, review classification, provider role and reassessment; do not recycle v1's conclusion automatically. A public-authority customer has its own applicable registration and impact-assessment duties. These are distinct from the private-employer case assumptions.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 5–6, 17, 40–49, 111 and 113; Annexes IV–VIII

blocks: Use three outcomes: **ready for the specified checked scope**, **not ready because a required condition is unmet**, or **needs further review because decisive facts or interpretation are unresolved**. Record each conclusion's facts, dated sources, evidence links, conditions, decision owner and next action. Unknowns should remain visible. Passing this lesson demonstrates reasoning practice, not certification of an actual product.

sources.title: AI Act, 27 July 2026 baseline: Articles 5–6, 17, 40–49, 111 and 113; Annexes IV–VIII

questions.prompt: Northbridge's complete stipulated dossier supports all the stated release checks. Which conclusion is proportionate?

options.blocks: Ready within the specified checked scope, with continuing duties and owners.
options.reason: The conclusion follows the stated evidence without claiming every possible legal clearance.

options.blocks: Permanently certified for every future purpose and jurisdiction.
options.reason: The evidence concerns a dated system/version and bounded scope.

options.blocks: Ready solely because it uses a popular model.
options.reason: Model popularity does not establish the dossier's legal conditions.

questions.prompt: Harbour has an unverified assessor scope and a v0 certificate for v1. Is its stated release ready?

options.blocks: Ready because a certificate exists, whatever its scope.
options.reason: Certificate existence does not establish relevant scope or version coverage.

options.blocks: Ready because a sales deadline creates a derogation.
options.reason: Commercial urgency does not supply an applicable statutory authorisation.

options.blocks: Not ready on these facts; resolve the identified assessment gaps.
options.reason: The stipulated required assessment is not supported for this release.
